description: Tavily site structure mapping. Given a starting URL, returns a flat list of URLs that describe the site's structure (no page content). Use to discover which pages exist on a site before deciding which to extract.

tools.name: tavily_map
tools.short_description: Map a website's structure - returns a list of URLs without reading page content
tools.description: Return a list of URLs discovered by following links from the starting URL. Use this BEFORE tavily_extract or tavily_crawl when you want to know what pages a site has, or to narrow down which pages are worth reading. Fast and cheap (no page content extracted). For actually reading the pages, use tavily_extract on the URLs you select.

url.description: The starting URL to map. Must be http or https.

max_depth.description: How many link-hops to follow when discovering URLs (1-5).

limit.description: Maximum number of URLs to return (1-100).

instructions.description: Optional natural-language guidance for the mapper (e.g. 'focus on documentation', 'exclude the blog').

returns.description: Map results with a list of discovered URLs
